subject: Mathematics
purpose: External demand inventory and GCDR design base. Kept separate from the existing Physics Vector Algebra preparation slice.

provenance.rights_note: Question text, options, figures and solutions are not mirrored. Store source locators and concise demand summaries only.

canonical_state_model.single_source_of_truth: All arrows, planes, determinants, projections, normals, areas and algebraic readouts must derive from the same vector arrays.

fallacy_rigs.name: Vector-equation inversion / no vector division
fallacy_rigs.wrong_model: divide by a vector to isolate r
fallacy_rigs.correct_model: use cross/dot identities and expose the free component parallel to the reference vector before auxiliary constraints

verified_source_exemplar.demand_summary: Solve a vector constrained by a cross-product equation and an auxiliary dot-product condition.

fallacy_rigs.name: Vector triple product non-associativity
fallacy_rigs.correct_model: evaluate each parenthesization independently; use BAC-CAB and geometric containing-plane checks

verified_source_exemplar.demand_summary: The live page contains nested cross-product/vector-triple-product demand; exact exemplar will be pinned during the next source-index enrichment pass.
A parallelogram-area problem is expressed using diagonal vectors, exposing the factor-of-one-half distinction.

fallacy_rigs.name: Projection versus rejection
fallacy_rigs.wrong_model: confuse scalar projection, vector projection and perpendicular component
fallacy_rigs.correct_model: separate signed scalar projection, vector projection on b, and rejection a - proj_b(a)

verified_source_exemplar.demand_summary: Projection constraints on vectors require separating magnitude-only projection from the directed projected vector.

fallacy_rigs.name: Coplanarity versus collinearity
fallacy_rigs.wrong_model: zero scalar triple product means all vectors are parallel
fallacy_rigs.correct_model: zero scalar triple product means the spanned volume is zero; vectors are linearly dependent/coplanar

verified_source_exemplar.demand_summary: The live corpus repeatedly uses coplanarity/determinant conditions.
